meta.title: Twenty People, Nineteen Burgers
meta.textType: counting: numbers to twenty and plurals

paragraphs: Sam's family is at the sea. They have lunch on the sand. The sea is blue and nice. Grandma and Grandpa are here too. "How many people are here?" asks Sam. Sam counts the family. "There are twenty people!" Mom has the burgers. "Nineteen burgers," says Mom. "Twenty people and nineteen burgers?" asks Sam. Mom looks at the burgers. Sam counts them again.

Grandma has a big cake. Grandpa has candy for the children. "I have sixteen candies," says Grandpa. "I do not want a burger," says Sam. "I can have cake and candy." "Good, Sam," says Mom. Now twenty people have food.

Then Sam looks at the sea. "Look at the jellyfish!" says Sam. "I can see twelve jellyfish." The jellyfish are white. A small green lizard is on the sand. "Look! Two lizards!" says Sam. The lizards look at the family. The family is happy. Sam has a big smile.
text.summary: Sam's big family has lunch at the sea. Sam counts twenty people and nineteen burgers, and he finds a kind answer.
